name: rx6600
description: AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Navi 23, RDNA 2, gfx1032) at its 2044 MHz game clock: one Vortex core per compute unit (CU).

sources.NUM_THREADS, ISSUE_WIDTH, FETCH_WIDTH, N: 2 SIMD32 units per CU, each with its own scheduler, running wave32 at one instruction per clock; 20 waves per SIMD (AMD RDNA architecture whitepaper)
sources.NUM_ALU_LANES, NUM_FPU_LANES: 32 VALU lanes per SIMD for FP32 and INT32 (no dual-issue on RDNA 2)
sources.NUM_LSU_LANES, NUM_LSU_BLOCKS: One vector-memory path per CU behind the L0 vector cache, 64 B per clock (16 x 4 B lanes)
sources.DCACHE_SIZE: 16 KB L0 vector cache per CU, 128 B lines. The 128 KB graphics L1 per shader array, shared by its CUs, has no Vortex level: cores in a socket would share the L0-sized dcache, so the L1 is left out
sources.ICACHE_SIZE: 32 KB instruction cache per WGP (two CUs), i.e. 16 KB per CU
sources.LMEM_LOG_SIZE, LMEM_NUM_BANKS: 64 KB LDS per CU in CU mode (128 KB per WGP), 32 banks of 4 B = 128 B per clock per CU; Vortex banks are XLEN wide (8 B), so 16 banks carry the same bytes per clock
sources.L2_SIZE, L2_NUM_WAYS, L2_NUM_BANKS: 2 MB L2, one slice per 16-bit memory channel, 16-way
sources.L3_ENABLE, L3_SIZE, L3_NUM_WAYS, L3_NUM_: 32 MB Infinity Cache (first generation) behind the L2, modelled as the Vortex L3, one bank per memory channel
sources.PLATFORM_MEMORY_TYPE, PLATFORM_MEMORY_NU: 128-bit GDDR6 at 14 Gbps: 4 devices x 2 x16 channels = 8 channels, 8 x 2 B x 14 GT/s = 224 GB/s; latency not calibrated
sources.NUM_MUFU_LANES: Transcendentals at a quarter rate per SIMD: 16 per CU per clock
sources.EXT_TCU_ENABLE: Off: RDNA 2 has no matrix units (only packed dot-product instructions)
sources.VM_ENABLE, EXT_A_ENABLE, EXT_ZACAS_ENABL: GPUVM paging, global and LDS atomics with compare-swap, FP16 instructions and workgroup barriers, and the graphics pipeline (4 texture units per CU, rasterizers, ROPs) of a gaming part
sources.xlen: 64-bit machine: 64-bit pointers and FP64. FP64 runs at 1/16 of FP32 (4 per CU per clock) on the part
sources.FMA64_PE_RATIO: FP64 FMA at 1/16 of the FP32 rate: 4 FP64 results per CU per clock, 2 per SIMD; 32 FPU lanes / 16 = 2 F64 FMA PEs. FP64 division, square root and conversions take the FDIV/FSQRT/FCVT rates
sources.FDIV_PE_RATIO, FSQRT_PE_RATIO: Transcendentals (reciprocal, reciprocal square root, on which division and square root are built) run at a quarter of the FP32 rate on GCN, RDNA and CDNA: FPU lanes / 4
sources.reference: fp32_lanes is the vendor FP32 core count (FP32 FMA lanes per chip, clock-free); dram_bandwidth_gbs the vendor peak. Checked by ci/profile_check.py
